stitches.name: Stitches
stitches.description: Heals up to 10 health and applies a stitches effect that absorbs incoming damage. When stitches are consumed, deals back the initial heal amount as damage.

adrenaline.name: Adrenaline
adrenaline.description: Grants +10 speed but applies heart strain for 5 turns, which reduces speed by 3 at the start of each turn.

drip.name: Drip
drip.description: Applies a drip status effect that heals 1 health at the start and end of each turn for 25 activations.
